message.content:
This looks like a CBP ruling on compression limiters. The candidate headings are:

- 7318 (screws, bolts, nuts, washers and similar articles of iron or steel). A compression limiter is a sleeve or spacer, so it may fit 7318.29 (other non-threaded articles) or 7318.22 (other washers).
- 8708 (parts of motor vehicles). Chapter 73 articles are generally not excluded by Section XVII Note 2, which excludes only certain base metal parts of headings 7301-7326 under 2(a). Under that note, parts of general use as defined in Note 2 of Section XV, including articles of heading 7318, are excluded from Section XVII. So 7318 prevails.

Within 7318, a non-threaded sleeve falls under 7318.29. The statistical suffix for 7318.29.00 is 7318.29.0000 (HTSUS 7318.29.00 "Other non-threaded articles"), but 7318.29 is divided into 7318.29.0030 (bushings) and 7318.29.0060 (other). A sleeve or spacer pressed into plastic is closest to a bushing. I recall CBP rulings on compression limiters classifying them under 7318.29.0000, and I will go with the current 10-digit number for "other".

{"hts_code": "7318.29.0000", "reason": "A steel non-threaded sleeve or spacer used with a bolt is a non-threaded fastener article of heading 7318, and Section XVII Note 2 excludes it from motor vehicle parts in 8708."}
